questions.q: What core concept is repeated throughout the book?
questions.why: The book emphasizes a semi‑scientific approach to product development.

questions.q: What method is used to compare product versions?
questions.why: Split‑testing (A/B testing) is described as a key technique.

questions.q: Which metric is considered a vanity metric?
questions.why: Likes are called vanity metrics that don't pay the bills.

questions.q: What does the hypothesis in a startup aim to test?
questions.why: Hypotheses test whether customers will buy the product.

questions.q: What is the main goal of split‑testing?
questions.why: It helps distinguish features customers value from those they don't.
